design_rules.canonical_key: domain.property; do not encode direction, component, temperature, pressure, frequency, wavelength, species, phase, or model branch in the key
design_rules.quantity_kind: QUDT QuantityKind is an attribute, not the primary key. mdb:* denotes a small local QuantityKind extension where QUDT has no exact kind.
design_rules.value_representation: A property may be scalar, vector, tensor, complex, curve, table, or function.
design_rules.model_parameters: Constitutive-model coefficients belong under model.<model>.<parameter>, not in this flat physical-property catalog.
design_rules.interface_properties: interface.* records belong to a material/phase pair, not to one bulk material.

quantity_kind_extensions.mdb:ElectricPotentialPerTemperature: electric potential divided by thermodynamic temperature
quantity_kind_extensions.mdb:FlowResistivity: pressure gradient divided by superficial velocity
quantity_kind_extensions.mdb:PiezoelectricChargeCoefficient: strain per electric field, equivalently electric displacement per stress
quantity_kind_extensions.mdb:PiezoelectricVoltageCoefficient: electric field per stress, equivalently strain per electric displacement
quantity_kind_extensions.mdb:PiezoelectricStressCoefficient: stress per electric field, equivalently electric displacement per strain
quantity_kind_extensions.mdb:PyroelectricCoefficient: electric polarization change per thermodynamic temperature change
quantity_kind_extensions.mdb:ThermalResistancePerArea: temperature difference times area divided by heat flow rate

relationships.rule: Only two are independent for an isotropic linear elastic material; derived values must retain provenance.
These may be alternative representations of the same constitutive behavior and require an explicit coordinate/tensor convention.
